criteria.acmg_2015: Null variant (nonsense, frameshift, canonical ±1/2 splice, initiation codon, exon deletion, etc.) in a gene where loss of function is an established disease mechanism.
criteria.clingen_general: Use the ClinGen PVS1 decision tree; consider transcript relevance, NMD, exon relevance, alternative initiation, and the importance/extent of the truncated region. Strength may be downgraded.
criteria.processing_rule: Eligible LoF consequence → confirm gene–disease LoF mechanism → select relevant transcript → predict NMD → if NMD escape, assess critical region/protein loss → assign VS/S/M/P per PVS1 decision tree. If mechanism is unknown, do not auto-fire.
criteria.implementation_default: NMD rule may use PTC >50 nt upstream of final exon–exon junction as a practical rule. Gene constraint (e.g., pLI/LOEUF) is supporting context only, not a substitute for disease mechanism.
criteria.required_inputs: normalized variant; consequence; transcript/exon/CDS position; NMD context; gene–disease mechanism; protein region/domain; alternative transcript/initiation
criteria.db_api: VEP; MANE/RefSeq; ClinGen Gene-Disease Validity; UniProt/InterPro
criteria.va_outcome: PVS1 if default VS; otherwise PVS1_<strength>; PVS1_not_met when evaluated and not met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for annotation/NMD/mechanism evidence; Statement may be used for curated gene-disease mechanism. No dedicated PVS1 StudyResult profile in VA-Spec v1.0.
criteria.review_point: LoF disease mechanism, biologically relevant transcript, exon/region relevance.

criteria.acmg_2015: Same amino-acid change as an established pathogenic variant, caused by a different nucleotide change.
criteria.clingen_general: For splice-related variants, ClinGen splicing guidance allows comparison of equivalent predicted/observed splice effects; avoid double counting with PVS1/PP3.
criteria.processing_rule: Missense: same residue + same alternate amino acid + different nucleotide change + comparator is sufficiently established Pathogenic; exclude cases where comparator pathogenicity is mainly due to a different splice effect. Splicing: evaluate equivalent splice consequence under ClinGen guidance.
criteria.implementation_default: Use primary evidence behind the comparator where possible; do not rely solely on an unreviewed database label.
criteria.required_inputs: protein/codon consequence; comparator variant; comparator classification/evidence; splice prediction/RNA evidence
criteria.db_api: ClinVar; NCBI Variation; ClinGen Evidence Repository; VEP; PubMed
criteria.va_outcome: PS1 if default strong; otherwise PS1_<strength>; PS1_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Statement describing comparator pathogenicity plus generic StudyResult for amino-acid/splice equivalence.
criteria.review_point: Quality/independence of comparator pathogenic evidence and splice-effect equivalence.

criteria.acmg_2015: De novo variant in a patient with the disease and no family history, with maternity and paternity confirmed.
criteria.clingen_general: Use ClinGen PS2/PM6 de novo point framework; points depend on parental relationship confirmation and phenotype consistency; aggregate independent probands to determine strength.
criteria.processing_rule: Proband carries ALT; both parents do not; parental relationships confirmed; genotype QC passes → assign proband points based on phenotype consistency → sum independent probands → map total to evidence strength.
criteria.implementation_default: Typical genotype QC can require DP/GQ thresholds, but these are implementation policy, not ACMG/ClinGen universal thresholds.
criteria.required_inputs: trio genotypes; parental relationship confirmation; genotype QC; phenotype; family history; independent proband count
criteria.db_api: Internal family/case data; HPO; MONDO; ClinGen Gene-Disease Validity
criteria.va_strength: supporting / moderate / strong / very strong per point framework
criteria.va_outcome: PS2 if default strong; otherwise PS2_<strength>; PS2_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for trio/genotype data plus Statement/StudyResult for phenotype assessment.
criteria.review_point: Phenotype consistency and independence of observations.

criteria.acmg_2015: Well-established functional studies supportive of a damaging effect on the gene or gene product.
criteria.clingen_general: ClinGen functional-evidence guidance evaluates assay relevance, controls, validation variants, replication/statistics and allows strength adjustment.
criteria.processing_rule: Require curated assay record → confirm assay measures a disease-relevant mechanism → assess positive/negative controls and validation → damaging result → assign strength from assay validity/quality. Do not infer assay validity from a PMID alone.
criteria.implementation_default: Prefer curated functional evidence or MAVE data with explicit assay metadata. Keep raw assay result separate from ACMG interpretation.
criteria.required_inputs: assay type/system/readout; controls; validation variants; result; statistics; replication; PMID/MaveDB ID
criteria.va_strength: supporting / moderate / strong / very strong when justified
criteria.va_outcome: PS3 if default strong; otherwise PS3_<strength>; PS3_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: ExperimentalVariantFunctionalImpactStudyResult and/or a functional-impact Statement supported by that StudyResult.
criteria.review_point: Assay validity and relevance to disease mechanism.

criteria.acmg_2015: Prevalence of the variant in affected individuals is significantly increased compared with controls.
criteria.clingen_general: No disease-agnostic single threshold is adopted here; case-control statistics and/or independent-case evidence must be evaluated in disease context.
criteria.processing_rule: If case-control data exist, calculate/ingest effect estimate and confidence interval; require enrichment supporting association. For rare variants without adequate case-control data, use a documented case-count rule only when justified by the applicable general/local method.
criteria.implementation_default: Do not treat ClinVar review status or number of submissions as PS4 evidence.
criteria.required_inputs: case/control AC/AN; OR/RR; CI; p-value; independent probands; phenotype; study design
criteria.db_api: PubMed; case-control datasets; internal case database
criteria.va_outcome: PS4 if default strong; otherwise PS4_<strength>; PS4_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult containing case-control/case-count statistics; source Document for study.
criteria.review_point: Study design, population matching, ascertainment, independence of cases.

criteria.acmg_2015: Located in a mutational hotspot and/or critical and well-established functional domain without benign variation.
criteria.clingen_general: No universal disease-agnostic hotspot window is specified; domain/hotspot evidence must be justified from curated biology/variant distribution.
criteria.processing_rule: Variant lies in a curated critical domain/hotspot + pathogenic variation is enriched + benign variation is absent/limited → PM1. If only generic domain overlap is known, route to review rather than auto-fire.
criteria.implementation_default: fastVEP-style ±5 aa / ≥3 pathogenic / 0 benign is an implementation heuristic, not a ClinGen universal rule.
criteria.required_inputs: protein position; domain/hotspot coordinates; pathogenic/benign variants in region; domain function
criteria.va_outcome: PM1 if default moderate; otherwise PM1_<strength>; PM1_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for domain/hotspot annotation and local variant spectrum; supporting Statements/Documents.
criteria.review_point: Whether the region is truly critical/hotspot and sufficiently depleted of benign variation.

criteria.default_strength: moderate (ACMG); generally supporting under ClinGen recommendation
criteria.acmg_2015: Absent from controls, or at extremely low frequency for a recessive disorder, in population databases.
criteria.clingen_general: ClinGen recommends using PM2 at Supporting strength in general and emphasizes reliable population data/rarity rather than naïve absence.
criteria.processing_rule: Use reliable ancestry-aware population frequency/FAF. If absent or sufficiently rare under the configured general implementation rule, emit PM2_supporting. If coverage/AN/region quality is insufficient, mark internal status NOT_EVALUATED rather than not-met.
criteria.implementation_default: No universal disease-agnostic nonzero AF cutoff is asserted. If adopting fastVEP defaults (e.g., AD/unknown ≤4e-5; AR ≤7e-5), label them IMPLEMENTATION thresholds.
criteria.required_inputs: AC; AN; AF; ancestry-specific AF; FAF; coverage/quality; inheritance context
criteria.va_outcome: PM2_supporting (because strength is adjusted from ACMG default moderate); PM2_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: CohortAlleleFrequencyStudyResult; use ancillaryResults/qualityMeasures for FAF and coverage/quality metadata as needed.
criteria.review_point: Rarity threshold policy and reliability of population observation.

criteria.acmg_2015: For recessive disorders, detected in trans with a pathogenic variant.
criteria.clingen_general: ClinGen PM3 point framework weights phase confirmation, classification of the other allele, homozygous observations and independent probands; total points map to strength.
criteria.processing_rule: For each proband: determine phase and classification of second allele → assign points → cap/reconcile repeated evidence as required → sum independent probands → map to Supporting/Moderate/Strong/Very Strong.
criteria.implementation_default: A practical mapping often uses 0.5/1/2/4 points for Supporting/Moderate/Strong/Very Strong; preserve proband-level points.
criteria.required_inputs: proband genotype; second variant; second-variant classification; phase; parental genotypes; phenotype; homozygous status
criteria.db_api: Internal family data; ClinVar; ClinGen Evidence Repository
criteria.va_outcome: PM3 if default moderate; otherwise PM3_<strength>; PM3_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for phase/genotypes plus Statement for classification of the second allele.
criteria.review_point: Second-allele classification, phase certainty and duplicate probands.

criteria.acmg_2015: Protein length changes due to in-frame deletions/insertions in a non-repeat region or stop-loss variants.
criteria.clingen_general: Avoid double counting with PVS1; interpret protein-region relevance and repetitive sequence context.
criteria.processing_rule: Consequence is in-frame insertion/deletion or stop-loss + changes protein length + not solely in non-functional repetitive region + same molecular consequence is not already counted under PVS1 → PM4.
criteria.implementation_default: If repeat/domain annotation is unavailable, do not auto-fire.
criteria.required_inputs: consequence; amino-acid length change; repeat annotation; functional region/domain
criteria.va_outcome: PM4 if default moderate; otherwise PM4_<strength>; PM4_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for consequence, length change, repeat/domain annotation.
criteria.review_point: Functional relevance of affected region and overlap with PVS1.

criteria.acmg_2015: Novel missense change at an amino-acid residue where a different missense change is established as pathogenic.
criteria.clingen_general: Comparator pathogenicity and mechanism must be sufficiently established; same amino-acid substitution belongs under PS1, not PM5.
criteria.processing_rule: Evaluated variant is missense + same residue has a different Pathogenic missense + comparator has adequate evidence + not same AA substitution → PM5.
criteria.implementation_default: Prefer comparator with reviewed primary evidence; exclude comparator whose pathogenicity is mainly splice-mediated if not mechanistically comparable.
criteria.required_inputs: residue; evaluated AA change; comparator AA change; comparator classification/evidence
criteria.va_outcome: PM5 if default moderate; otherwise PM5_<strength>; PM5_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Statement describing comparator pathogenic variant plus generic StudyResult for residue equivalence.
criteria.review_point: Quality and mechanistic relevance of comparator evidence.

criteria.acmg_2015: Assumed de novo, but without confirmation of maternity and paternity.
criteria.clingen_general: Evaluated jointly with PS2 using the ClinGen de novo point framework; parental relationship status and phenotype specificity control points/strength.
criteria.processing_rule: Proband carries ALT + available parent(s) do not + parental relationship not fully confirmed → PM6 candidate → phenotype/relationship points → aggregate independent probands → strength.
criteria.implementation_default: Genotype QC thresholds are implementation policy and must be provenance-tracked.
criteria.required_inputs: proband/parent genotypes; relationship confirmation status; genotype QC; phenotype; independent probands
criteria.va_strength: supporting / moderate / strong / very strong when justified by point framework
criteria.va_outcome: PM6 if default moderate; otherwise PM6_<strength>; PM6_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for trio/family observations and phenotype evidence.
criteria.review_point: Whether the observation qualifies as confirmed vs assumed de novo.

criteria.acmg_2015: Co-segregation with disease in multiple affected family members in a gene definitively known to cause the disease.
criteria.clingen_general: ClinGen PP1/BS4/PP4 guidance recommends quantitative/structured segregation assessment and integration with phenotype/locus specificity; strength may increase.
criteria.processing_rule: Build informative pedigree observations → account for inheritance, penetrance, phenocopy and locus heterogeneity → calculate segregation LR/points or equivalent structured measure → map to evidence strength.
criteria.implementation_default: Do not use simple affected-carrier count alone when pedigree structure materially changes evidence.
criteria.required_inputs: pedigree; genotypes; affected status; age; penetrance assumptions; inheritance; phenotype/locus specificity
criteria.va_outcome: PP1 if default supporting; otherwise PP1_<strength>; PP1_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for segregation observations; Statement/StudyResult for phenotype specificity.
criteria.review_point: Informative meioses, penetrance, phenocopy, locus heterogeneity.

criteria.acmg_2015: Missense variant in a gene with low rate of benign missense variation and where missense variants are a common disease mechanism.
criteria.clingen_general: Gene-level constraint alone is insufficient; disease mechanism and pathogenic variant spectrum must support missense causality.
criteria.processing_rule: Variant is missense + established gene-disease mechanism includes pathogenic missense + benign missense variation is low relative to expectation → PP2. If disease mechanism is unknown, do not auto-fire.
criteria.implementation_default: Missense constraint Z-score can be a heuristic, but must not replace gene-disease mechanism evidence.
criteria.required_inputs: variant type; gene-disease mechanism; pathogenic/benign missense spectrum; gene constraint
criteria.db_api: ClinGen Gene-Disease Validity; gnomAD constraint; ClinVar
criteria.va_outcome: PP2; PP2_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Statement for disease mechanism plus generic StudyResult for gene-level missense constraint/variant spectrum.
criteria.review_point: Whether missense is genuinely a common mechanism for the evaluated disease.

criteria.acmg_2015: Multiple lines of computational evidence support a deleterious effect on the gene/gene product.
criteria.clingen_general: Use calibrated predictors rather than simple majority voting; ClinGen provides calibrated evidence strengths for missense prediction and separate splicing guidance.
criteria.processing_rule: Select predictor appropriate to variant mechanism → compare score with a documented calibrated interval → emit PP3 at the calibrated strength. Keep protein-impact and splice-impact evidence distinct and reconcile double counting.
criteria.implementation_default: fastVEP uses REVEL ≥0.644 Supporting, ≥0.773 Moderate, ≥0.932 Strong; SpliceAI ≥0.2 as Supporting. Treat these as adopted implementation thresholds with source/version.
criteria.required_inputs: predictor name/version; raw score; variant type; calibration source/threshold; splice context if applicable
criteria.db_api: REVEL; SpliceAI; VEP; other calibrated predictor source
criteria.va_outcome: PP3 if supporting; PP3_moderate / PP3_strong when adjusted; PP3_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for computational predictor score(s); no dedicated computational StudyResult profile in VA-Spec v1.0.
criteria.review_point: Calibration source/version and double-counting with splice/functional evidence.

criteria.acmg_2015: Patient phenotype/family history is highly specific for a disease with a single genetic etiology.
criteria.clingen_general: ClinGen guidance explicitly links PP4 phenotype specificity with locus heterogeneity and segregation evidence (PP1/BS4); disease-specificity must be demonstrated.
criteria.processing_rule: Normalize phenotype → compare with candidate disease/gene phenotype → assess specificity and genetic heterogeneity → combine with segregation context as required → assign evidence strength or route to curator.
criteria.implementation_default: Do not impose a universal HPO similarity cutoff as a ClinGen rule.
criteria.required_inputs: HPO terms; diagnosis; age/sex; labs; family history; candidate disease/gene; locus heterogeneity
criteria.va_strength: supporting or adjusted strength when justified
criteria.va_outcome: PP4 if default supporting; otherwise PP4_<strength>; PP4_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Statement or generic StudyResult capturing phenotype-to-disease/gene match and specificity assessment.
criteria.review_point: Phenotype specificity and alternative genetic etiologies.

criteria.acmg_2015: Reputable source recently reports variant as pathogenic, but evidence is not available to the laboratory.
criteria.clingen_general: ClinGen recommends that PP5 not be used; retrieve and evaluate primary evidence instead.
criteria.processing_rule: Never produce MET under the General ClinGen policy. Use external classifications only to discover primary evidence.
criteria.implementation_default: Internal workflow status = NOT_APPLICABLE/DEPRECATED.
criteria.required_inputs: None for scoring; external classifications may be used for evidence discovery
criteria.va_outcome: Do not emit a MET EvidenceLine. If the implementation explicitly evaluates it as an ACMG criterion and records not-met, PP5_not_met is schema-compatible; deprecation itself should be kept in Extension/local workflow metadata.
criteria.va_evidence_item: Normally none.
criteria.review_point: N/A; deprecated.

criteria.acmg_2015: Allele frequency is >5% in population databases.
criteria.clingen_general: ClinGen BA1 recommendations emphasize ancestry/population context, adequate allele number, data quality, and an exception list.
criteria.processing_rule: Use reliable population AF/FAF → require adequate observed alleles → if frequency >0.05 and not a BA1 exception → BA1. If frequency quality is unreliable, NOT_EVALUATED internally.
criteria.implementation_default: A minimum observed allele count/AN gate may be adopted; document it. The user source proposes at least 2,000 observed alleles based on ClinGen guidance.
criteria.required_inputs: population; AC; AN; AF/FAF; homozygotes; quality; BA1 exception status
criteria.va_outcome: BA1; BA1_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: CohortAlleleFrequencyStudyResult with sourceDataSet/cohort and relevant quality metadata.
criteria.review_point: Exception-list status and unreliable frequency regions.

criteria.acmg_2015: Allele frequency is greater than expected for the disorder.
criteria.clingen_general: Requires comparison with the maximum credible allele frequency expected for the disease; depends on prevalence, inheritance, penetrance and allelic/genetic contribution.
criteria.processing_rule: Compute/obtain disease-specific maximum credible AF → compare ancestry-aware observed AF/FAF → if observed exceeds threshold, BS1. Without disease-level assumptions/threshold, do not claim a general automatic BS1.
criteria.implementation_default: A fixed fallback such as AF>1% is an implementation heuristic only, not a universal ClinGen rule.
criteria.required_inputs: AF/FAF; prevalence; inheritance; penetrance; genetic contribution; allelic contribution; threshold assumptions
criteria.va_outcome: BS1 if default strong; otherwise BS1_<strength>; BS1_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: CohortAlleleFrequencyStudyResult plus Statement/StudyResult carrying disease-frequency assumptions.
criteria.review_point: Maximum credible AF assumptions.

criteria.acmg_2015: Observed in a healthy adult individual for a recessive, dominant, or X-linked disorder where full penetrance is expected at an early age.
criteria.clingen_general: Interpretation depends on expected penetrance, age of onset, genotype/zygosity and reliable phenotype ascertainment.
criteria.processing_rule: Confirm disease expected to be highly penetrant by observed age → identify genotype incompatible with disease in well-phenotyped healthy individual(s) → assess zygosity/inheritance → BS2. Population counts alone require caution.
criteria.implementation_default: fastVEP-style AC or homozygote-count heuristics are implementation defaults, not universal ClinGen thresholds.
criteria.required_inputs: genotype/zygosity; age; phenotype; penetrance; expected onset; inheritance; healthy-individual count
criteria.db_api: Well-phenotyped cohorts; PubMed; population datasets as supportive context
criteria.va_outcome: BS2 if default strong; otherwise BS2_<strength>; BS2_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for healthy-individual genotype/phenotype observations; population StudyResult may be supporting context.
criteria.review_point: Penetrance, age of onset and quality of phenotype ascertainment.

criteria.acmg_2015: Well-established functional studies show no damaging effect on protein function or splicing.
criteria.clingen_general: Same ClinGen functional-evidence framework as PS3; assay validity and controls determine whether/at what strength benign evidence is appropriate.
criteria.processing_rule: Require curated disease-relevant validated assay → normal/non-damaging result with appropriate controls/validation → assign strength from assay validity.
criteria.implementation_default: Keep raw assay result separate from ACMG interpretation and avoid double counting the same functional evidence.
criteria.required_inputs: assay; system; controls; validation variants; result; statistics; replication; PMID/MaveDB ID
criteria.va_strength: supporting / moderate / strong / very strong when justified
criteria.va_outcome: BS3 if default strong; otherwise BS3_<strength>; BS3_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: ExperimentalVariantFunctionalImpactStudyResult and/or functional-impact Statement.
criteria.review_point: Assay validity and disease-mechanism relevance.

criteria.acmg_2015: Lack of segregation in affected members of a family.
criteria.clingen_general: ClinGen PP1/BS4/PP4 guidance requires structured segregation interpretation and consideration of penetrance, phenocopy and locus heterogeneity.
criteria.processing_rule: Identify genotype-phenotype inconsistency → test whether reduced penetrance, phenocopy, age-dependent onset, heterogeneity or genotype error can explain it → if not, quantify non-segregation evidence → BS4.
criteria.implementation_default: Do not auto-fire from a single discordant relative without contextual review.
criteria.required_inputs: pedigree; genotypes; phenotypes; ages; penetrance; inheritance; locus heterogeneity
criteria.db_api: Internal pedigree data; HPO/MONDO as context
criteria.va_outcome: BS4 if default strong; otherwise BS4_<strength>; BS4_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for segregation/non-segregation observations.
criteria.review_point: Phenocopy, reduced penetrance, age-dependent onset, locus heterogeneity.

criteria.acmg_2015: Missense variant in a gene for which primarily truncating variants are known to cause disease.
criteria.clingen_general: Disease mechanism and known pathogenic variant spectrum are required; gene constraint alone should not define the rule.
criteria.processing_rule: Variant is missense + established disease mechanism is predominantly LoF/truncating + pathogenic missense mechanism is not established → BP1.
criteria.implementation_default: Counts of known pathogenic missense variants may be used as a heuristic but must be provenance-tracked.
criteria.required_inputs: variant type; disease mechanism; known pathogenic variant spectrum
criteria.va_outcome: BP1; BP1_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Statement for disease mechanism plus generic StudyResult for pathogenic variant spectrum.
criteria.review_point: Whether missense disease mechanism is truly absent/rare.

criteria.acmg_2015: Observed in trans with a pathogenic variant for a fully penetrant dominant disorder, or observed in cis with a pathogenic variant in any inheritance pattern.
criteria.clingen_general: Interpret phase in the context of inheritance and penetrance; require reliable phasing and comparator classification.
criteria.processing_rule: Obtain two variants + phase + inheritance → if configuration satisfies BP2 logic and second variant is sufficiently established pathogenic → BP2. Unknown phase → do not auto-fire.
criteria.implementation_default: Phased family/read-based evidence should be preferred to inferred phase.
criteria.required_inputs: two variants; phase; inheritance; penetrance; second-variant classification/evidence
criteria.db_api: Internal family data; ClinVar; ClinGen Evidence Repository
criteria.va_outcome: BP2; BP2_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for phase/genotypes plus Statement for second-variant pathogenicity.
criteria.review_point: Phase certainty and inheritance/penetrance assumptions.

criteria.acmg_2015: In-frame deletion/insertion in a repetitive region without a known function.
criteria.clingen_general: Confirm that the repeat region lacks established functional importance; avoid conflict with PM4.
criteria.processing_rule: In-frame insertion/deletion + overlaps repetitive region + no established functional domain/critical region → BP3. If domain/repeat interpretation is uncertain, review.
criteria.implementation_default: RepeatMasker overlap alone is insufficient if the region has known function.
criteria.required_inputs: indel length/frame; repeat annotation; functional domain/region annotation
criteria.va_outcome: BP3; BP3_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for in-frame consequence, repeat and domain annotation.
criteria.review_point: Functional relevance of repeat region.

criteria.acmg_2015: Multiple lines of computational evidence suggest no impact on gene/gene product.
criteria.clingen_general: Use calibrated computational predictors instead of majority vote; benign calibrated intervals can support adjusted strengths.
criteria.processing_rule: Select calibrated predictor → compare score to benign calibration interval → assign BP4 strength → reconcile with splice/functional evidence and avoid applying benign prediction where incompatible with high-confidence null/splice evidence.
criteria.implementation_default: fastVEP uses REVEL ≤0.290 Supporting, ≤0.183 Moderate, ≤0.016 Strong, ≤0.003 Very Strong; SpliceAI ≤0.1 Supporting. Record predictor/version and calibration source.
criteria.required_inputs: predictor/version; score; variant type; calibration thresholds; splice context
criteria.va_outcome: BP4 if supporting; BP4_moderate / BP4_strong / BP4_very_strong when adjusted; BP4_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for computational score(s); no dedicated computational StudyResult profile in VA-Spec v1.0.
criteria.review_point: Calibration source/version and conflicts/double counting.

criteria.acmg_2015: Variant found in a case with an alternate molecular basis for disease.
criteria.clingen_general: Alternative diagnosis must adequately explain the phenotype; dual diagnosis must be considered.
criteria.processing_rule: Identify alternate causal variant/diagnosis → assess whether it fully or near-fully explains phenotype → if evaluated variant lacks independent phenotype contribution, BP5; if dual diagnosis remains plausible, MANUAL_REVIEW internally.
criteria.implementation_default: Do not auto-fire solely because another pathogenic variant exists.
criteria.required_inputs: patient phenotype; alternate variant/gene; alternate classification; phenotype match; dual-diagnosis assessment
criteria.db_api: Internal patient data; ClinVar; HPO; MONDO
criteria.va_outcome: BP5; BP5_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Statement describing alternative molecular diagnosis plus phenotype-match evidence.
criteria.review_point: Completeness of alternative explanation and dual diagnosis.

criteria.acmg_2015: Reputable source recently reports variant as benign, but evidence is not available to the laboratory.
criteria.clingen_general: ClinGen recommends that BP6 not be used; retrieve and evaluate primary evidence instead.
criteria.processing_rule: Never produce MET under the General ClinGen policy. External benign classifications are evidence-discovery aids only.
criteria.implementation_default: Internal workflow status = NOT_APPLICABLE/DEPRECATED.
criteria.required_inputs: None for scoring; external classifications may be used for evidence discovery
criteria.va_outcome: Do not emit a MET EvidenceLine. If explicitly evaluated and recorded not-met, BP6_not_met is schema-compatible; deprecation belongs in Extension/local workflow metadata.
criteria.va_evidence_item: Normally none.
criteria.review_point: N/A; deprecated.

criteria.acmg_2015: Synonymous variant with no predicted splice impact and low nucleotide conservation.
criteria.clingen_general: ClinGen splicing guidance refines location/prediction/RNA considerations and warns against double counting across PVS1/PS1/PP3/BP4/BP7.
criteria.processing_rule: Synonymous/noncoding candidate appropriate for BP7 → outside splice-critical positions as defined by adopted rule → calibrated splice prediction supports no impact → conservation/RNA evidence does not suggest function → BP7. Reconcile with other splice criteria.
criteria.implementation_default: A practical implementation may use SpliceAI ≤0.1 and a documented conservation threshold; any intronic distance limits are implementation policy, not universal ClinGen thresholds.
criteria.required_inputs: consequence; exon/intron offset; splice predictor/version/score; conservation; RNA evidence if available
criteria.va_outcome: BP7; BP7_not_met
criteria.va_evidence_item: Generic StudyResult for splice prediction/conservation; Statement or functional StudyResult for RNA evidence where available.
criteria.review_point: Splicing edge cases, RNA evidence, and double counting.
